svg.text: Chatham AI Advisory hosting platform on Azure: multi-client solution architecture
One subscription per client (ADR 0001), built from the same Terraform stamp, inside Platform Engineering's landing zone. Every client resource below is private; nothing is shared between clients.
Entra ID tenant and governance (owned by Platform Engineering / P&T)
ADR 0002: AI Advisory is a landing-zone consumer. P&T owns hierarchy, policy, identity and connectivity; we build inside their guardrails.
Subscription vending: P&T template per client (MG placement, IPAM /22, Entra groups, budget owner, AOAI quota request)
Azure Policy add-on (Gatekeeper) enforces the same initiatives inside every AKS cluster. Exemptions are time-boxed and recorded in an ADR.
acme's own circuit -> hub ExpressRoute gateway
-> firewall: acme ranges to acme AGW:443 only
IPsec IKEv2 to hub VPN gateway, BGP off
(same stamp as acme; column not drawn)
Private endpoint in woodgrove's OWN subscription
-> App Gateway Private Link. No hub routing,
Corp network, Entra ID SSO + PIM
clients; WAF at edge; reaches the
client App Gateway via Private Link
Client DNS forwards only its own zone
Client staff sign in to the app with Entra ID
(B2B guests or the client's own tenant via
No user ever reaches a model, vault or
Readers: standing Reader + AKS RBAC Reader.
Client circuits linked by authorization key
IPsec IKEv2 per client, BGP OFF so no
One rule per client: its ranges ->
its own AGW IP:443. Default deny.
Spokes use it as DNS server
zone (linked to resolver VNet by P&T)
Jump path to private AKS API
Applied to public IPs by policy
Spoke side created by the stamp; hub side
Spokes never peer with each other.
peering, stamp creates its own privatelink
Ring 0 | standalone | compute: Container Apps | ingress: none (internal only)
snet-agw 10.100.2.0/24 NSG: GatewayManager, AzureLB, 443 from approved sources
Not deployed: internal canary, reached by the platform team only.
The same module switches on with an ingress block in clients/chatham.
Container Apps environment (internal LB, workload profiles)
modules/container-apps; zone redundant; static internal IP; private DNS zone for the env domain; logs
to the client Log Analytics workspace
Image by digest from shared ACR
App calls models only through the AI gateway (no direct model role).
Key Vault, Storage and Search via private endpoints, resource-scoped roles.
snet-apim 10.100.1.64/26 NSG: ApiManagement:3443, AzureLB:6390, 443 from workload
AI gateway: API Management, internal VNet (modules/ai-gateway)
validate-azure-ad-token (only id-<client>-app, no keys) -> llm-token-limit per caller
llm-emit-token-metric (Client, CallerAppId) -> managed identity to models -> backend aoai-primary
Circuit breaker per backend (429/5xx, honours Retry-After); prompt bodies not logged by default
Private DNS zone <apim>.azure-api.net; gateway + token logs -> client LAW / App Insights
snet-pe 10.100.1.0/26 NSG: 443 only from workload, agw, apim subnets
PaaS (public network access disabled; reached only through the private endpoints above)
Operations and guardrails in this subscription
Config: terraform/clients/chatham/ ~40 lines | state: tfstate-chatham | deploy: id-deploy-chatham
